hero.title: Frequently Asked Questions
hero.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about Latin Music Mastery.

what.question: What is Latin Music Mastery?
what.answer: Latin Music Mastery is a comprehensive online platform dedicated to teaching authentic Latin American music. We offer HD video lessons, interactive notation, AI-powered practice tools, and a supportive community -- all designed to help you master styles from salsa and bossa nova to cumbia, tango, and beyond.

experience.question: Do I need any prior musical experience?
experience.answer: Not at all! We have courses designed for every skill level, from absolute beginners who have never touched an instrument to advanced musicians looking to expand their repertoire. Each course clearly indicates the recommended skill level, so you can find the perfect starting point.

instruments.question: What instruments are covered?
instruments.answer: We currently offer courses for Guitar, Piano, Bass, Drums/Percussion, Vocals, Trumpet, Saxophone, Violin, and Cuatro. We are continually expanding our instrument coverage based on student demand.

lessons.question: How do the lessons work?
lessons.answer: Each course includes HD video lessons with synchronized notation that follows along as you watch. You will learn techniques, theory, and repertoire through a structured curriculum. Our PlaySense AI tool can listen to your playing and provide real-time feedback, helping you practice more effectively between lessons.

cost.question: How much does it cost?
cost.answer: We offer flexible pricing to fit your needs. The Per Instrument plan is $14.99/month and gives you full access to all courses for a single instrument. The All-Access plan is $69.99/month and unlocks every course, instrument, and feature on the platform -- perfect for multi-instrumentalists and curious learners.

trial.question: Is there a free trial?
trial.answer: Yes! You get a 14-day free trial with full access to the platform. No credit card is required to start. Experience everything Latin Music Mastery has to offer before committing to a subscription.

cancel.question: Can I cancel anytime?
cancel.answer: Absolutely. There are no long-term contracts or cancellation fees. You can cancel your subscription at any time from your account settings, and you will continue to have access until the end of your current billing period.

payment.question: What payment methods are accepted?
payment.answer: We accept all major credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover) and PayPal. All payments are processed securely through Stripe.

playsense.question: What is PlaySense?
playsense.answer: PlaySense is our AI-powered practice tool that listens to your playing in real time through your device microphone. It provides instant feedback on pitch accuracy, rhythm, timing, and dynamics -- helping you identify areas for improvement and track your progress over time. Think of it as having a patient, always-available practice partner.

download.question: Can I download lesson materials?
download.answer: Yes! Sheet music, tablature, and backing tracks are all available for download with your subscription. You can practice offline and use the materials however you like for personal learning.

mobile.question: Is there a mobile app?
mobile.answer: Our platform is fully responsive and works great on mobile browsers, tablets, and desktops. A dedicated mobile app is on our roadmap for the future, but for now you can access all features through your mobile browser.

certificate.question: Do I get a certificate?
certificate.answer: We provide achievement badges and progress certificates as you complete courses and reach milestones. These are great for tracking your learning journey and sharing your accomplishments with others.

contact.question: How do I contact support?
contact.answer: Visit our contact page at /contact or email us directly at support@latinmusicmastery.com. Our support team typically responds within 24 hours.

requestContent.question: Can I request new content?
requestContent.answer: Absolutely! We love hearing from our community. You can submit content requests through our contact page or community forums. Many of our most popular courses have been created based on student suggestions.

hero.title: About Latin Music Mastery
hero.subtitle: Our mission is to make authentic Latin American music education accessible to everyone.

mission.paragraph1: Latin Music Mastery was born from a deep respect for the music, culture, and traditions of Latin America.
mission.paragraph2: For generations, Latin music has moved the world through its rhythm, soul, and unmistakable energy. From the syncopated language of Cuban son to the elegance of bossa nova, the fire of salsa, the sophistication of mambo, and the depth of countless regional styles, these traditions carry stories, identities, and musical wisdom that deserve to be preserved and shared.
mission.paragraph3: Our mission is to make authentic Latin music education accessible to students around the world. We bring together master musicians, thoughtfully structured lessons, and modern learning technology to create a platform that teaches more than notes and patterns. Every course is designed to help students understand the technique, history, feel, and cultural foundation behind the music.
mission.paragraph4: Whether you are just beginning your musical journey or looking to deepen your artistry, Latin Music Mastery gives you the tools, guidance, and inspiration to grow with confidence. This is more than learning an instrument. It is an invitation to connect with the roots, language, and soul of Latin music.

journey.description: Latin Music Mastery was created to fill a gap in music education: the need for a structured, authentic, and culturally grounded way to learn Latin music. What began as a vision to preserve and share the musical traditions of Latin America has grown into a platform built for students around the world. By bringing together master musicians, modern learning tools, and carefully designed courses, we are creating a space where technique, rhythm, history, and culture come together. Our journey is just beginning, but our mission is clear: to help students connect with Latin music at a deeper level and carry its legacy forward with knowledge, respect, and passion.

tips.meterBody: Needle left is flat: tighten. Needle right is sharp: loosen. Green center means you're within the in-tune window.
tips.centsBody: Hz is the raw pitch. Cents is distance from the nearest correct note; 100 cents is one semitone.
tips.orderBody: Go slightly flat first and tighten into pitch. Strings hold tuning better when the last move raised them.

home.pickFirstCourseBody: Choose an instrument and a genre to start your journey — your progress saves automatically.

slowDown.title: Slow It Down
slowDown.body: Practice tricky passages at half tempo. Speed follows accuracy — nail the notes first, then gradually increase.

listen.title: Listen Actively
listen.body: Spend 10 minutes today just listening to your favorite Latin track. Focus on one instrument and how it fits the clave.

clave.title: Clap the Clave
clave.body: Before you play, clap the clave pattern for 2 minutes. Internalizing the rhythm makes everything else easier.

record.title: Record Yourself
record.body: Record a short clip of your practice. Listening back reveals things you miss in the moment.

isolate.title: Isolate the Hard Part
isolate.body: Pick the two hardest measures and loop them 20 times. Targeted repetition beats playing through the whole piece.

feeling.title: Play With Feeling
feeling.body: Even during exercises, add dynamics. Playing musically from the start builds better habits than adding expression later.

ears.title: Warm Up Your Ears
ears.body: Sing or hum the melody before you play it. If you can hear it internally, your hands will follow more naturally.
